stem.text: The graph shows the variation of the velocity $v$ of the particle with time $t$.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis t, both starting at 0, showing a straight line rising from the origin to the upper right.

stem.text: Which graph shows the variation of the velocity $v$ with the acceleration $a$ of the particle?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis a, both starting at 0, showing a curve rising steeply from the origin and then flattening.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis a, both starting at 0, showing a curve rising gently from the origin and then more steeply.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis a, both starting at 0, showing a horizontal straight line.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis a, both starting at 0, showing a vertical straight line.
